question: Should crawl-remote permanently retain this hidden canary as versioned production state, with deployments and rollbacks failing unless both predecessor and new runtimes satisfy its release-bound six-query contract?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent, but tests cannot authorize durable production data retention or decide the operational rollout contract across two repositories and predecessor releases.

options.title: Approve ordered staged rollout
options.body: Accept the permanent canary contract, deploy the query-provenance prerequisite first, and require staged seed, propagation, query, hidden-listing, and rollback proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign lifecycle
options.body: Require a different canary cleanup or migration model before merge so rollback does not depend on retained production state.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this draft open until the base evidence core and crawl-remote provenance direction are independently accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve ordered staged rollout
recommendation.body: Accept the permanent canary contract, deploy the query-provenance prerequisite first, and require staged seed, propagation, query, hidden-listing, and rollback proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the connected Gitcrawl deployment stack and can present the rollout and rollback contract for maintainer approval.
